subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: After the zero-timestamp correctness repair, should an observable Teams uninstall retain transcript artifacts while clearing every active session and proactive-send binding?
rationale: The code can enforce either outcome, but deciding how much conversation history survives uninstall is a privacy and data-retention choice that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Retain artifacts, clear bindings
options.body: Preserve transcript files but rotate the session and remove Teams route, delivery, origin, provider-binding, and cached conversation-reference metadata.

options.title: Delete matching history
options.body: Remove matching transcript data as well as active session and proactive-send bindings when Teams emits uninstall.

options.title: Pause for broader policy
options.body: Hold the PR until uninstall retention behavior is defined consistently across channels.

recommendation.title: Retain artifacts, clear bindings
recommendation.body: Preserve transcript files but rotate the session and remove Teams route, delivery, origin, provider-binding, and cached conversation-reference metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership spans both the Teams conversation store and session freshness contract, making this the strongest available decision-routing signal.
